text:
sophia: FYI I opened a docs PR that adds a short KV-cache cost breakdown example and both Node + Python snippets. Keeps it focused — small table showing hits/misses cost and a note about grouping by tracekey. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1284 :memo:

kiran: Thanks — skimmed it. Two quick questions: 1) are we calling the metric kv_cache_hit_count or kv_cache_hits in the console? need to match exact metric name for the dashboard link. 2) can we show an example with a prefix-based cache key so users see grouping?

sophia: Good call. In the draft I used `kv_cache_hits` (that's what the runtime emits currently). I'll change the note if we standardize. Adding a tiny example for prefix grouping now.

ben: heads-up — console dashboards expect metric name `kv_cache_hit_total` in the cost view (we've had inconsistencies). I'll update the metric alias in the platform layer but we should avoid a user-facing mismatch. Suggest we reference the dashboard by ID instead of name so links don't rot. e.g. https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/DB-82-kv-cost

noah: minor UX ask — could we include a short migration note for teams that still use older dashboard templates? something like "if you see zeros, check that metric alias mapping is set to kv_cache_hits -> kv_cache_hit_total". That saved a customer last week. :sweat_smile:

sophia: added a Migration note + a 1-line troubleshooting tip. Pasted the Node + Python snippets below in the PR. Please sanity-check; want to keep them ~5 lines each so they fit in the quickstart card.

sophia: ```js
// Node example: attach trace key and record cache hit annotation
await client.call({
  model: 'gpt-small',
  input: prompt,
  metadata: { trace_key: 'user-123/prefixA' }
});
// server-side: increment metric 'kv_cache_hits' when prefix matches
```

sophia: ```py
# Python example: add prefix to KV cache and annotate for cost rollup
resp = client.generate(prompt, metadata={'trace_key': 'org-alpha/promo'})
# on hit: metrics.increment('kv_cache_hits')
```

kiran: code looks fine. maybe change the metadata key to `tracekey` (one word) — our SDKs normalize that. Also add a one-liner about TTLs affecting cost (short TTL -> more misses -> higher token cost).

sophia: updated to `tracekey` and added TTL sentence.

ben: I'll own updating the dashboard alias and will push a small console redirect so the PR link can point to DB-82. Assigning myself to review the PR now. :+1:

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #1284 — all link checks ok (except external console link flagged, see PR comments).

sophia: thanks @ben! action items: 1) ben to update dashboard alias & push redirect 2) kiran to confirm runtime emits mapping for `kv_cache_hits` -> `kv_cache_hit_total` in next deploy 3) noah to quick-review migration blurb 4) sophia will squash the small formatting commits and request final review. I'll ping when done.

ben: noted. I'll post the dashboard redirect link here once done. ETA EOD.

noah: reviewed migration blurb, LGTM except one typo fix (s/affects/affect).

sophia: fixed typo and squashed. Thanks all — requesting final review from @ben when you have a minute. :pray:
